question: Does the deterministic issue #421 package-order grammar preserve the frozen whole-run path at its null setting and change only the preregistered first-action mediator when enabled?
decision: Admit this structural mechanism to a separately preregistered CRN experiment only if every frozen-path identity, controlled-surface isolation, negative-control, registered-level and zero-ledger assertion passes.

evidenceBoundary.trigger: The exact equal-cohort complementarity panel rejected the sole scalar candidate because Afterimage produced only 3 of 128 policy witnesses while the other three packages cleared their frozen gates.
evidenceBoundary.measuredBottleneck: Afterimage acquisition was common but its exact complementarity was rare at Ward setup priority 0, while historical Ward setup priority 2 controls were materially more active. This identifies action order or setup as the next structural mechanism, not another payoff or acquisition scalar.
evidenceBoundary.forbidden: This preflight is identity and direct-mediator evidence only. It may not support a balance, package, detector or acceptance claim and it may not reopen the closed scalar family.

frozenPath.comparison: Canonical equality of complete whole-run rows produced before packageOrder existed.

factorDefinition.name: packageOrder
factorDefinition.type: research-only binary deterministic action-order grammar outside the sampled policy vector
factorDefinition.enabledRule: During a non-lethal pilot choice, and before the unchanged normal score argmax, consider only a registered aspect-valid producer-consumer pair for which both cards are held and legal and its registered mediator is absent. Reject a producer whose previewed self-loss is lethal. If more than one pair qualifies, select the producer with the highest unchanged normal combat score; ties retain registered pair order. Return that producer using its unchanged legal target.
factorDefinition.intendedMediator: The deterministic first legal card identity when both package cards are co-held and the package mediator is absent.
factorDefinition.allowedDownstreamConsequences: Only consequences caused by that changed action order may differ after the selected card is played.
factorDefinition.forbiddenDirectEffects: The factor must not enter policy resolution or policy_snapshot, change any combat score or target, consume RNG, alter acquisition scoring, cross an aspect boundary, act when the mediator is present, or affect a hand without a registered legal pair.
factorDefinition.mechanisticJustification: The failed package had adequate acquisition but insufficient producer-before-consumer setup. A deterministic package grammar tests that measured bottleneck directly without another scalar, optimiser, ML or RL method.
factorDefinition.aliasStructure: No alias is permitted. packageOrder is crossed only against its own null within the same pair and mediator-presence state while wardSetupPriority, acquisitionPriority, content, policy, enemy, hand, energy and seed remain fixed. Mediator-present cells are preregistered negative-control anchors, not another causal factor.

anchors.frozenWholeRuns: One Duskblade and one Ashwarden sampled-policy whole run retain the exact old identifiers, seeds, policy identities, result rows, trajectories and RNG cursors.
anchors.controlledHand: Every surface contains exactly the registered producer, registered consumer and strike against gravewarden at 3 energy under the same resolved policy.
anchors.negativeControls: For every package, mediator-present off and on cells must select the same first action while all direct fields remain exact.
anchors.positiveControls: For every package, the mediator-absent enabled cell must select the registered producer and content inspection must show that producer establishes the registered mediator.

estimands.nullIdentity: Canonical equality of each omitted-setting row, its explicit full-null row and the corresponding pre-packageOrder frozen row, including policy, complete ordered trajectory, final RNG and result.
estimands.directMediator: Within each package and mediator-presence state, packageOrder 1 minus 0 for firstChoice, holding all other inputs exact.
estimands.directIsolation: Exact equality within each off-on contrast for resolved policy, every normal combat score and RNG before and after choice.
estimands.negativeControl: Exact equality of firstChoice under packageOrder 0 and 1 when the registered mediator is already present.
estimands.trustBoundary: packageOrder 2 must terminate the probe non-zero before a row is accepted.

successRule: All whole-run null rows exactly reproduce the frozen path; all four absent-mediator enabled cells choose their registered producer; every present-mediator negative control is exact; policy, scores and RNG are exact within every contrast; every producer establishes only its registered package mediator through existing content; the unregistered level fails closed; and the ledger is byte-identical before and after.
futilityRule: Any exact mismatch, unintended direct-field movement, failed positive or negative control, unregistered-level acceptance or ledger mutation rejects packageOrder and forbids simulator observations under it.
inconclusiveRule: An immutable-input mismatch, missing frozen cache object, unavailable Godot 4.7.2 stable surface, process failure unrelated to a registered assertion, corrupt cache, timeout or unreadable ledger yields no identity conclusion and no authority for simulator observations.
stoppingRule: Run this fixed plan once. Stop at the first failure. On success, admit only the exact binary grammar and proceed to a new frozen CRN protocol; on futility or inconclusive result, run no simulator row.
